**Finding submitted: missing (high severity).**

The Agreement has a three-year committed term (§8.1) but no termination-for-convenience right anywhere — §9 offers only for-cause exits (material breach, insolvency, Customer special-cause), and §8.2 (180-day non-renewal) and §27.3 (force-majeure exit) are not substitutes. Under the rule, absence of a Customer convenience right in a multi-year term is walk-away territory.

Proposed redline (validated, preferred level): new §9.4 giving us a 30-day convenience termination right, in whole or in part, without penalty and with a refund of prepaid Fees for the post-termination period, and confirming Vendor has no reciprocal convenience right during a term — consistent with the current bargain (Vendor has no such right today). Fallback of 60 days' notice offered in the comment.
